title: Tinyland v4 Bazel action plan
description: Exact projection of GloriousFlywheel Core.dhall action intent for the v4 ci-templates workflow. It contains only Bazel actions and abstract REAPI capability requirements; no runner, pool, resolved platform, endpoint, credential, tenant, repository identity, lifecycle, publication, or apply authority.

schema_version.description: ActionPlan/v4 schema 3. Versions 1 and 2 predate the mandatory result-disposition boundary and are not accepted.

actions.description: Bazel actions keyed by their log and evidence identity. JSON object keys make action names unique by construction. One v4 workflow invocation selects exactly one declared name and the compiled GF action client consumes that member's complete command, target, and capability tuple.

capability.description: Abstract REAPI demand understood by the GloriousFlywheel v4 action client. The provider resolves it to current platform and worker supply; this value is never a runner label or resolved gloriousflywheel-rbe-* platform identity. A declared capability with no admitted supply fails during resolution rather than disappearing from the provider-blind consumer schema.

result.description: Closed result disposition. There is no omitted or default mode.

command.description: Bazel command passed verbatim to the compiled GF action client.

targets.description: Finite workspace-local Bazel labels passed verbatim to the compiled v4 action client. Flags and external-repository labels are not accepted.

capability.description: The one abstract execution requirement joined to provider supply by the GF controller. One action resolves once and therefore cannot select mutually exclusive architectures.
